fields.description: When unchecked, the MCP server endpoint returns 404 — external clients cannot reach Friday's tools.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: External MCP clients see exactly the skills THIS Agent Profile is allowed to use (role + permission-matrix scoped), and every tools/call runs as this profile through the governed dispatcher (matrix + audit + approval gate).
fields.label: Exposed Agent Profile

fields.options: Endpoint: POST /api/method/frappe.friday_core.mcp.server.handle. Authenticate with the X-MCP-Token: <token> header (a custom header, NOT Authorization: Bearer — Frappe's auth layer would reject a Bearer token before the endpoint runs). Speaks MCP streamable-HTTP JSON-RPC (initialize / tools/list / tools/call).

fields.description: Static token an MCP client must present in the X-MCP-Token header. Stored encrypted. Generate a long random value and treat it as a credential.
fields.label: MCP Token
